Officer's narrative
At approximately the scene of a low-speed head-on collision in Katy, Texas, I found Driver 1 and Driver 2 operating
vehicles that had come together nose to nose. Driver 1 is the named driver on the policy for the vehicle involved.
Driver 2 reported neck and back strain and was evaluated at the scene. The reported symptoms are consistent with
the type of impact described by both drivers. Photographs taken at the scene confirm the general position of the
vehicles and some areas of contact, but they do not show whether all of the visible damage resulted from this
collision. No independent witnesses were located. Driver 1 and Passenger both stated that Driver 2 was in the vehicle
at the time of impact, and this was not disputed. Neither vehicle had any prior damage known to the parties or noted
during the inspection. Further review of the damage is recommended to determine the extent to which it can be
attributed to this incident.
</page>
